newsitem.title: USA: Boise says Q1 loss reflects lower prices.
newsitem.headline: Boise says Q1 loss reflects lower prices.

text.p: Boise Cascade Corp on Monday said its first-quarter loss of $0.51 per share was caused by deteriorating paper prices.
For grades of paper produced by Boise Cascade, the price declines averaged $175 a ton, or 26 percent in the first quarter, with the average price falling to $510 from $685 in the 1996 first quarter.

Boise Cascade, which posted a profit of $0.32 a share in the year-earlier period, manufactures and distributes paper and wood products and distributes office products and building materials. It also owns 2.4 million acres of timberland.
